changes_made.change_description: Added missing method implementation: createTaskValidated(TaskCreateRequestValidated request) - Converts validated request to standard TaskCreateRequest and delegates to createTask method
Added missing method implementation: validateTaskInput(TaskCreateRequestValidated request) - Validates title, description, priority, and status fields and returns ValidationResponse
Updated getUserTasks method to accept Pageable parameter instead of separate int parameters for page and size

root_cause: The TaskService interface declared two methods (createTaskValidated and validateTaskInput) that were not implemented in TaskServiceImpl, causing compilation failures. All required dependencies were already present in pom.xml.
solution_applied: Added the two missing method implementations to TaskServiceImpl.java. The createTaskValidated method converts a TaskCreateRequestValidated object to a TaskCreateRequest and delegates to the existing createTask method. The validateTaskInput method performs validation on the request fields and returns a ValidationResponse object.
verification_status: Code fixes applied successfully. The TaskServiceImpl now implements all methods declared in the TaskService interface. The build should succeed on the next attempt.
